sources.label: Official Disturbia size guide (Apparel chart, cm)

audit: Old /pages/size-guides URL redirected to the homepage; guide is at /pages/size-guide. Apparel table read from DOM including the cm cells. Was 6 letter rows XS-2XL with UK ranges; now UK 6-24, each with its own US/EU as printed. Stored notes claimed bust and hip are equal: the chart has hips 7 cm above bust (UK 10 87-92 bust, 94-99 hip), so that sentence and the 'size up if full-hipped' fit advice were removed. XS (UK 6-8) 81/61/84 -> UK 6 77-82/61-66/84-89; M (UK 10-12) 91/71/91 -> UK 10 87-92/71-76/94-99, UK 12 92-97/76-81/99-104. Knitwear chart (double sizes) not used.
notes: Sheffield-based UK alt/goth brand founded 2003. Sizing is unisex-influenced — the women's range uses a boxy, relaxed cut. Apparel runs UK 6–24. Popular secondhand for graphic tees, band tees, and alt-cut dresses. Quality varies by garment — hoodies and tees consistent, dresses more variable.
